messages.text: The failed cache searches were command-escaping errors, not missing evidence; the source checks still confirmed Windows’s intentional inode-sort rejection and canonicalization behavior. I’m rerunning only the cache lookup with literal PowerShell paths, then will patch from the actual `term_grid` implementation rather than approximating its packing rules.

commands.preview: $root=Join-Path $HOME '.cargo\registry\src'; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Filter Cargo.toml -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-String -Pattern '^name = "term_grid"$' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path
